ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 64
   C. 9
   D. 8

2. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x > 5

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

4. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

5. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

6. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

7. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 12
   C. 2
   D. 14

9. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

10. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

12. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

13. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

14. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

15. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 121
   D. 122

16. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 26
   D. 10

17. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19

18. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 24

19. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 49

20. Solve for x: x + 5 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 7
   C. 11
   D. 5

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 75
   C. 40
   D. 30

22. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 24

23. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

24. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
